title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and explore full, half and quarter turns.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 reads a position scene. Q2 types how many quarter turns make a full turn. Q3 watches a half turn. Q4 orders quarter, half and whole. Q5 watches a quarter turn. Q6 taps every half-turn name. Q7 predicts a quarter turn. Q8 and Q9 type how the parts fit. Q10 performs a quarter turn this way.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, supported quarter turns and one performed quarter turn. Medium varies starts and uses the clock-hand cue for both ways. Hard adds three-quarter turns and four performed turns. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not only a bigger turn.
